tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Meridian Dispatch travel guides: long-form dispatches, country guides, town guides, venues (sights, museums, beaches, parks), trails, events and ski resorts. Returns ranked pages with a summary and a citable URL.

tools.name: get_destination
tools.description: The Meridian Dispatch guide to a country or a town: why go, how long to stay, when to go, getting there and around, practical FAQ answers, a structured fact sheet where one exists (nights, months, travel times, areas to stay, ranked top things, day trips, watch-outs), the places worth your time (wit

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: The Meridian Dispatch field record for one place: the best time to go, how long it takes, effort, season, access, how to get there and what goes wrong. Works for sights, trails, scenic drives, events and ski resorts. Takes a meridiandispatch.com page URL, or a name with its town or country.

tools.name: get_dispatch
tools.description: A Meridian Dispatch long-form dispatch (a reported piece on one place: headline, standfirst, opening excerpt, links to the town and country guides) or itinerary (a country route over N days: the bases in order, nights in each, where to stay and every day's activities by part of the day, each linked

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Festivals and events worth planning a trip around, from the Meridian Dispatch events guide: dates of the current edition, the best day to go, when to book, where to stay and practical tips. Filter by month and/or country.

tools.name: best_of
tools.description: Meridian Dispatch's ranked lists of the best places to visit, for the world or one country, overall or by category (landmarks, museums, towns, beaches, parks, wilderness, hiking trails, scenic drives, viewpoints, wildlife and more). Use for 'top things to do in X' and 'best beaches in X'.

tools.name: when_to_go
tools.description: Best time to visit, from the Meridian Dispatch guides. Give a destination for its best months in the guide's own words plus events there, or a month for the countries, towns, trails, ski resorts and festivals the guides recommend then ('where to go in March').

tools.name: nearby
tools.description: Places covered by Meridian Dispatch near a place or a coordinate, nearest first, with straight-line distance: day trips from a base, what else to see near a sight.

tools.name: create_itinerary_link
tools.description: Generate an itinerary import link: turn a day-by-day travel itinerary into a shareable "Add Itinerary to Meridian Dispatch" link. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
